title: The modal collects the schedule then optional last-service dates
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset that has a customer, and a schedule to enrol it on. Seed them:
  3. ↳ Ensure a schedule exists (Settings > Maintenance > New schedule + at least one service).
  4. ↳ Open an asset that has a customer (from Customers > a customer > Assets, or from Work Orders) and open its Maintenance tab (the last tab on the asset page).
  5. The asset has prior completions for some services of the same name; pick a schedule whose services partly match.
custom_steps:
1. Pick a schedule and read the fields the modal fills with (services and a last-service date per service).
  2. Check which last-service dates are pre-filled and from where; try to set one in the future.
  3. Read the modal title, the unit/customer wording, and how "(optional)" is shown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The modal collects, in order: the schedule, then one optional last-service date per service; current readings are not collected here.
  • Each last-service date is pre-filled from the most recent completion on this asset of a same-named service (any schedule), else blank; the advisor can change it, a renamed service has no match, blank means counting starts today, and the date cannot be in the future.
  • The title is static with the unit and customer in the body at normal weight, "(optional)" sits in brackets inline with its label; enrolment applies the schedule as it stands, and a due date comes from a last-service date entered or recorded, else from today.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10564 (S7, Enrol an asset onto a schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S7; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R2: “The modal will collect, in order: the schedule, then one optional last service date per service. Current readings are not collected here”
  • S7-R4: “Each last service date is filled in with the most recent completion on this asset of a service with the same name, from any schedule, and is otherwise blank. The advisor can change it. A renamed service has no match. Blank means counting starts today ... The date cannot be in the future”
  • S7-R8: “(optional) will sit in brackets inline with its label”
  • S7-E5: “Enrolment applies the schedule as it stands. Nothing is skipped or negotiated”
  • S7-E3: “Enrolment never invents a past. A due date comes from a last service date the advisor entered or the system recorded, otherwise from today”
